label: Decision variables versus data
subgoals: Separate the quantities the tool may set from the given data
Classify derived quantities such as arrival times as functions of the variables
Choose an encoding that makes the rules linear or simple

label: Objective versus constraints
subgoals: Put hard requirements in constraints and the traded quantity in the objective
Recognize a weighted penalty term as a soft constraint
Rewrite a max objective as an auxiliary variable bounded by every term

label: Proxies, scaling and infeasibility
subgoals: Name the proxy and the signoff metric it stands in for
Normalize objective terms to comparable magnitudes before weighting
Trace infeasibility to the constraints, never to the objective
